name: Vue.js and Nuxt Front-End Development
certifications: Vue.js Certification from Certificates.dev (Junior, Mid-Level and Senior)

beginner.summary: For web developers and freshers who know HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Covers Vue 3 projects with Vite, templates and directives, reactivity with ref and reactive, computed values and watchers, events and v-model, conditional and list rendering, components, props, emits and slots, lifecycle hooks, the Composition API and composables, styling, Vue Router, Pinia, calling APIs, form validation, component testing and deployment.
prerequisites: Writes HTML, CSS and modern JavaScript
Has used npm and a code editor
outcomes: Build single-page applications with Vue 3 and the Composition API
Structure apps with components, routing and Pinia stores
Connect to APIs and validate forms

days.topic: Vue.js Overview and Project Setup with Vite
subtopics: What Vue is and the progressive framework idea
Creating a project with create-vue and Vite
Project structure and the entry point
The development server and hot module replacement
VS Code with the Vue (Official) extension
Options API and Composition API at a glance
days.lab_task: Scaffold a Vue 3 project with Vite and TypeScript, explore the generated files, change a component and watch hot reload, inspect the component tree in Vue DevTools and build for production.
days.deliverable: Running starter project in a Git repository
checks: App loads and updates on save without a full reload
Component tree and state visible in Vue DevTools
dist folder produced and served locally

days.topic: Templates, Interpolation and Directives
days.lab_task: Build a product card that binds text, images, classes and styles from data, highlights items on sale and safely renders a description without v-html.
checks: Sale items show the sale style
Image source and alt text come from data
Description renders as text with no injected HTML

days.topic: Reactivity with ref and reactive
subtopics: Reactivity with arrays and nested objects
days.lab_task: Build a shopping basket with ref and reactive state, show the bug caused by destructuring reactive state, fix it with toRefs and measure updates in DevTools.
days.deliverable: Basket component with notes on reactivity pitfalls
checks: Values update again after the fix

days.topic: Computed Properties and Watchers
days.lab_task: Add computed totals, discounts and tax to the basket, save the basket to localStorage with a watcher and debounce a search box with a watcher that cleans up its timer.
days.deliverable: Basket with computed values and persistence
checks: Only one search request after typing stops

days.topic: Event Handling and Form Input Binding with v-model
subtopics: Event modifiers: prevent, stop and once
v-model on inputs, checkboxes, radios and selects
v-model modifiers: lazy, number and trim
days.lab_task: Build a sign-up form with text, select, checkbox and radio inputs bound with v-model, trim and number modifiers, keyboard shortcuts and a submit handler that prevents double submission.
checks: Values arrive trimmed and typed correctly
Enter submits and Escape clears the form

days.topic: Conditional and List Rendering
subtopics: v-show and when to use it
Filtering and sorting lists with computed
days.lab_task: Build a task list with filtering, sorting, empty and loading states, use stable keys, and show the bug that appears when array indexes are used as keys.
checks: Visible tasks match the selected filter and order
Input state jumps to the wrong row
Input state stays with the right task

days.topic: Components and Props
days.lab_task: Split a product page into header, gallery, details and review components, pass data with typed props and defaults, and fix a component that mutates its props.
checks: Wrong prop types flagged by the type checker
No prop mutation warnings in the console
Class added by the parent appears on the child root

days.topic: Emitting Events and Component v-model
days.lab_task: Build a reusable quantity picker and rating input that emit typed events and support v-model with defineModel, and use them in the product page.
checks: Parent receives the payload with the right type
Parent state updates from the custom input
objectives: Share state between parent and child

days.topic: Slots and Content Distribution
subtopics: Card, modal and table components with slots
days.lab_task: Build a reusable modal with header, body and footer slots, a data table with a scoped slot for custom cells, and a page layout component used by three pages.
checks: Modal shows custom header and footer content
Table renders custom cells from row data
Three pages share the layout without duplication

days.topic: Lifecycle Hooks
subtopics: Working with the DOM after mount
days.lab_task: Build a live clock, a window resize tracker and a chart that initialises after mount, clean up every timer and listener, and prove there are no leaks after navigating away.
checks: Timers and listeners removed after unmount
Chart draws after mount without errors
State preserved when switching tabs with KeepAlive

days.topic: The Composition API and script setup
subtopics: Organising code by feature instead of option
Options API to Composition API side by side
Async setup and Suspense in brief
Typing with TypeScript in script setup
Using the Options API and Composition API in one project
Linting rules for Composition API code
days.lab_task: Convert three Options API components to script setup, group logic by feature, expose a method to a parent with defineExpose and focus an input with a template ref.
days.deliverable: Converted components with a style guide
checks: Input focused when the dialog opens

days.topic: Composables for Reusable Logic
subtopics: Accepting refs and getters as arguments
days.lab_task: Write composables for API loading with loading and error state, local storage sync and online status, replace duplicated code in three components and test the composables.
checks: Loading, success and error states tested
Online status shown with a VueUse composable

days.topic: Styling Vue Components: Scoped CSS and Tailwind
subtopics: Binding CSS with v-bind in style blocks
days.lab_task: Style the product page with scoped CSS and Tailwind, add a responsive layout, a dark mode toggle bound to CSS variables and a fade transition for the modal.
checks: Layout adapts at mobile and desktop widths
Component styles do not leak to other components

days.topic: Routing with Vue Router
days.lab_task: Add routing to the shop with list, detail, basket and account pages, nested account routes, query-based filters, a 404 page and lazy loading for heavy pages.
checks: Detail page loads from the route parameter
Filters restored from the query string
Page code loads only when visited

days.topic: State Management with Pinia
days.lab_task: Move basket and user state into Pinia stores, use getters for totals, call actions from several pages and inspect state changes in Vue DevTools.
checks: Basket count updates on every page
Actions and state changes visible in DevTools

days.topic: Fetching API Data in Vue Components
subtopics: fetch and axios in Vue apps
Fetching on mount and on route change
days.lab_task: Connect the shop to a REST API with loading and error states, refetch when the route changes, cancel stale requests and mock the API with Mock Service Worker for offline work.
checks: Only the latest request's data is shown
Error message and retry button shown
App runs against Mock Service Worker

days.topic: Form Validation with VeeValidate
days.lab_task: Add schema validation to sign-up and checkout forms with field errors, an async username check, server error mapping and accessible error announcements.
checks: Field errors shown next to each field
Server field errors shown on the right fields

days.topic: Testing Components with Vitest and Vue Test Utils
days.lab_task: Write tests for the product card, quantity picker, basket store and product list with mocked API calls, and run them in watch mode and in CI.
checks: Basket component test uses a test Pinia instance
Components covered at 80 percent or more

days.topic: Building and Deploying Vue Applications
subtopics: Deploying to Netlify, Vercel or static hosting
days.lab_task: Build the shop for production, deploy it to a static host with a history mode fallback, serve it behind NGINX with cache headers and set up preview deployments for pull requests.
checks: Hashed assets served with long cache headers
Pull request has its own preview URL
objectives: Deploy to static hosts and NGINX

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Recipe Finder Application
days.lab_task: Build a recipe finder with search, filters in the URL, recipe detail pages, favourites in a Pinia store, a validated submission form, tests and a production deployment, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL and demo recording
checks: Search, filters, favourites and submission all work
Deployed app works on mobile and desktop
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one app

intermediate.summary: For developers who build Vue applications at work. Covers TypeScript with Vue, advanced component patterns, advanced routing, Pinia in depth, server state with TanStack Query, Nuxt routing, rendering modes and data fetching, authentication, component libraries, design systems with Storybook, performance, accessibility, internationalisation, integration and end-to-end testing, transitions, real-time interfaces, large forms, error monitoring and CI/CD for Vue and Nuxt.
prerequisites: Builds Vue 3 components with the Composition API
Has used Vue Router and Pinia
Comfortable with TypeScript basics and REST APIs
outcomes: Build typed, well-structured Vue and Nuxt applications
Choose rendering modes and data fetching strategies in Nuxt
Make apps fast, accessible and international
Test, monitor and deliver Vue apps through CI/CD

days.topic: TypeScript with Vue: Typed Props, Emits and Stores
subtopics: Strict TypeScript settings for Vue projects
Typing refs, computed and template refs
Type checking with vue-tsc in CI
days.lab_task: Turn on strict mode in an existing Vue app, type props, emits, stores and API responses, build a generic select component and fail CI on type errors.
days.deliverable: Strictly typed application and CI check
checks: No type errors in strict mode
Type of the selected value follows the items
Pipeline fails on the type error

days.topic: Advanced Component Patterns: Provide and Inject, Renderless and Compound Components
subtopics: provide and inject for deep data
Compound components such as tabs and accordions
days.lab_task: Build compound tabs and accordion components with provide and inject, a renderless data fetcher, a toast system with Teleport and an async chart loaded with Suspense.
checks: Tabs work without passing props through every level
Toasts render at the body level above modals
Chart shows a fallback until loaded
objectives: Share context with provide and inject

days.topic: Advanced Vue Router: Guards, Lazy Loading and Nested Layouts
days.lab_task: Protect admin routes with guards using route meta and the user store, build public and admin layouts with nested routes, restore scroll position and handle cancelled navigations.
checks: Visit an admin page as a guest
Redirected to login and back after sign-in
Admin pages use the admin layout
Scroll position restored on the list page

days.topic: Pinia in Depth: Plugins, Persistence and Store Composition
days.lab_task: Reorganise the app into domain stores that use each other, write a plugin that logs actions, persist selected state and test stores with mocked API calls.
checks: Order store reads from the user store without circular imports
Every action logged with its duration

days.topic: Server State with TanStack Query for Vue
days.lab_task: Replace hand-written API loading with TanStack Query, add infinite scrolling, optimistic updates for favourites with rollback on failure and prefetch details on hover.
checks: Cached data shown instantly then refreshed
UI rolls back and shows an error

days.topic: Nuxt: File-Based Routing, Layouts and Rendering Modes
subtopics: Static generation and hybrid rendering with route rules
days.lab_task: Rebuild the shop in Nuxt with file-based routes, layouts and route middleware, prerender marketing pages, render product pages on the server and set SEO metadata.
checks: Product content present in server-rendered HTML
Marketing pages generated as static files
Title and description set per page

days.topic: Data Fetching in Nuxt: useFetch, useAsyncData and Server Routes
subtopics: Server routes and API handlers in Nitro
days.lab_task: Build Nuxt server routes for products and orders over a database, fetch them with useFetch without double requests, add lazy loading for reviews and handle errors with error pages.
checks: No duplicate request on the client after hydration
Server route returns data from the database
Custom error page shown with status code

days.topic: Authentication in Vue and Nuxt Applications
subtopics: Protecting routes on client and server
days.lab_task: Add login with sessions and an OAuth provider to the Nuxt app, protect pages and server routes, refresh sessions and hide admin controls from normal users.
checks: User session created after the provider login
Normal users never see admin actions

days.topic: Component Libraries: Vuetify, PrimeVue and Nuxt UI
subtopics: When to use a component library
Vuetify, PrimeVue and Nuxt UI compared
Data tables and forms from libraries
days.lab_task: Build the same admin screen with two libraries, theme both to the brand, compare bundle size and accessibility and recommend one for the team.
days.deliverable: Comparison report and themed admin screen
checks: Size difference measured for the same screen
Accessibility issues listed for both libraries

days.topic: Design Systems and Storybook for Vue
subtopics: Visual and interaction tests in Storybook
days.lab_task: Build button, input and card components from design tokens, document them in Storybook with controls, add interaction tests and publish the package to a private registry.
checks: Every component has stories and docs
Another app uses the published components

days.topic: Performance Optimisation: Lazy Components, v-memo and Bundle Analysis
subtopics: Measuring with Lighthouse and the Performance panel
days.lab_task: Profile a slow product list with 10,000 items, add virtual scrolling, v-memo and lazy components, cut the bundle size and record before and after Core Web Vitals.
checks: Scrolling stays smooth at 60 frames per second

days.topic: Accessibility in Vue Applications
subtopics: Testing with axe and screen readers
days.lab_task: Audit the shop with axe and a screen reader, fix focus management for modals and route changes, make the tabs component keyboard accessible and add accessibility lint rules to CI.
checks: Every feature usable without a mouse
Focus moves to the new page heading

days.topic: Internationalisation with Vue I18n
days.lab_task: Translate the shop into English, Hindi and Arabic with pluralisation, local currency and date formats, lazy-loaded language files, right-to-left layout and locale-prefixed routes in Nuxt.
checks: Currency and number formats follow the locale

days.topic: Integration and End-to-End Testing for Vue Apps
subtopics: Running tests in parallel in CI
days.lab_task: Write Playwright tests for sign-in, search, basket and checkout with mocked payments, add visual snapshots for key pages and run tests in parallel in CI.
days.deliverable: End-to-end test suite and CI job
checks: Checkout flow passes in three browsers
Snapshot test fails on a layout change
Suite time drops with parallel workers

days.topic: Animations and Transitions
subtopics: Libraries such as Motion for Vue
days.lab_task: Add list animations to the basket, route transitions between pages and a modal entrance animation, respect reduced motion settings and check performance in the browser.
checks: Items animate when added and removed
Animations off when reduced motion is set

days.topic: Real-Time Vue Interfaces with WebSockets and Server-Sent Events
days.lab_task: Build a live order tracker and support chat with WebSockets, update Pinia stores from events, reconnect after drops and throttle a high-frequency price feed.
checks: Users see who is online and typing
UI stays responsive under 100 updates per second
objectives: Keep state in sync with events

days.topic: Forms at Scale: Dynamic Forms and Schema Validation
days.lab_task: Build a multi-step insurance application form generated from a schema with repeating fields, cross-field rules, draft saving and file uploads.
checks: Draft restored after closing the browser
Inconsistent answers rejected with clear messages

days.topic: Error Handling, Logging and Monitoring with Sentry
subtopics: Sentry setup for Vue and Nuxt
days.lab_task: Add global error handling and component error boundaries, send errors with source maps to Sentry, enable performance traces and set an alert for new errors after a release.
checks: Error appears in Sentry with the original source line
Error boundary shows a fallback while the rest of the page works
Alert fires for the new error

days.topic: CI/CD and Deployment for Vue and Nuxt
subtopics: Lint, type check, unit and end-to-end tests
Deploying Nuxt to Node.js servers, serverless and edge
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that lints, type-checks and tests the Nuxt app, deploys preview environments for pull requests, deploys to production with approval and rolls back a bad release.
checks: All stages pass on a pull request
Each pull request gets a working preview

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Nuxt Booking Platform
days.lab_task: Build a booking platform in Nuxt with server routes, authentication, real-time availability, two languages, accessible forms, end-to-end tests, monitoring and a CI/CD pipeline, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL, test reports and presentation
checks: Booking flow works end to end with live availability
Accessibility, performance and test reports meet targets
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one product

advanced.summary: For senior front-end engineers and leads working on large Vue estates. Covers reactivity and rendering internals, Vapor Mode, large-application architecture, Nuxt layers and modules, SSR performance with Nitro, micro-frontends, monorepos, design systems at scale, performance engineering, security, state architecture and offline sync, plugin and library authoring, testing strategy, Vue 2 migrations, mobile and desktop apps, real user monitoring, edge deployment, AI features and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years building production Vue applications
Has led features across a team
outcomes: Explain and tune Vue reactivity and rendering
Architect large Vue and Nuxt platforms for many teams
Secure, monitor and migrate Vue estates

days.topic: Vue Reactivity Internals: Proxies, Effects and the Scheduler
subtopics: Effects, triggers and the reactive graph
days.lab_task: Build a tiny reactivity system that mirrors Vue's, compare it with Vue's source, write a custom debounced ref and manage effects outside components with effectScope.
days.deliverable: Mini reactivity system and explanation notes
checks: Mini system updates only affected effects
Debounced ref updates after the delay
All effects in the scope stop together

days.topic: Rendering Internals: Virtual DOM, Compiler Optimisations and Vapor Mode
subtopics: Vapor Mode compilation without a virtual DOM
When to drop to render functions
days.lab_task: Inspect compiled output for three templates, explain patch flags, rewrite a hot component as a render function, try Vapor Mode on a component and fix a hydration mismatch.
checks: Patch flags matched to template features
Render time measured before and after changes

days.topic: Front-End Architecture for Large Vue Applications
days.lab_task: Restructure a large Vue app into feature modules with public APIs, enforce boundaries with lint rules, add a data access layer and record three architecture decisions.
checks: Lint fails on a cross-feature import
Components no longer call fetch directly
Each decision lists options and consequences

days.topic: Nuxt at Scale: Layers, Modules and Hybrid Rendering
days.lab_task: Extract shared UI and auth into a Nuxt layer used by two apps, write a Nuxt module that adds analytics, and tune route rules for static, cached and dynamic pages.
days.deliverable: Shared layer, custom module and rendering plan
checks: Two apps use the layer without copied code
Module adds analytics through configuration only
Each route served by the planned rendering mode

days.topic: SSR Performance and Caching with Nitro
subtopics: Time to first byte and streaming
Caching API responses in Nitro storage
days.lab_task: Load test a server-rendered product page, add route and data caching with stale-while-revalidate, keep personalised parts uncached and find a server memory leak.
checks: Time to first byte and throughput measured
Cached pages served faster with correct freshness
Server memory stays flat after the fix

days.topic: Micro-Frontends with Vue and Module Federation
days.lab_task: Split the shop into shell, catalogue and account micro-frontends with Module Federation, share Vue as a single dependency, deploy one independently and measure the cost.
checks: Catalogue updated without redeploying the shell

days.topic: Monorepos for Vue Teams with pnpm and Turborepo
subtopics: Monorepo layout for apps and packages
days.lab_task: Combine two Vue apps and a component package into a pnpm monorepo with Turborepo caching, shared lint and TypeScript configuration and affected-only CI.
checks: All packages use the shared lint and TypeScript settings

days.topic: Design Systems at Scale with Vue
days.lab_task: Plan a breaking change to a shared button component, ship a codemod for consumers, track adoption across three apps and write the contribution guide.
checks: Contribution guide reviewed by two teams

days.topic: Advanced Performance Engineering for Vue Apps
subtopics: Long tasks and main thread work
days.lab_task: Set budgets for a slow Nuxt page, cut long tasks with lazy hydration and a web worker, measure third-party script cost and fail CI when budgets are exceeded.
checks: Heavy calculation no longer blocks input
CI fails when a budget is exceeded

days.topic: Security for Vue and Nuxt Applications
subtopics: Cross-site request forgery for server routes
days.lab_task: Find and fix planted issues in a Nuxt app: unsafe v-html, a leaked API key in the bundle, missing CSRF protection and a weak CSP, then add security scans to CI.
checks: No secrets found in the built bundle
Strict policy active without breaking the app

days.topic: State Architecture and Offline Data Sync
days.lab_task: Make a field inspection app work offline with IndexedDB, queue changes for background sync, resolve conflicts with the server and keep state in sync across tabs.
days.deliverable: Offline-capable app and state design document
checks: Queued changes reach the server when online
Conflicting edits resolved by the agreed rule

days.topic: Building Vue Plugins and Libraries
days.lab_task: Build and publish a Vue plugin and component library with tree-shakable exports, type declarations, a Nuxt module wrapper and a documentation site.
checks: Unused components removed from consumer bundles
Nuxt app installs the module and works

days.topic: Testing Strategy for Large Vue Codebases
subtopics: Unit, component, integration and end-to-end balance
days.lab_task: Assess the test suite of a large Vue app, rebalance it by risk, add contract tests with the API, run mutation testing on core logic and cut CI test time.
checks: Mutation score measured for core modules
API change breaks the contract test

days.topic: Migrating from Vue 2 to Vue 3 and from Options to Composition API
subtopics: Vue 2 end of life and risks
Options API to Composition API conversion
days.lab_task: Migrate a sample Vue 2 app with Vuex using the migration build, fix deprecations, move Vuex to Pinia, replace an incompatible library and plan the rest of the migration.
checks: App works without migration build warnings
Stores moved to Pinia with tests passing
Plan lists modules, risks and order

days.topic: Mobile and Desktop Apps with Vue, Capacitor and Tauri
subtopics: Sharing code between web and native
days.lab_task: Package the shop as an Android app with Capacitor using camera and push plugins, build a desktop version with Tauri and share 80 percent of the code with the web app.
days.deliverable: Mobile and desktop builds with a code sharing report
checks: Camera works on an Android device or emulator

days.topic: Observability and Real User Monitoring for Vue
subtopics: Tracing front-end requests to back ends
days.lab_task: Collect Web Vitals and traces from real users, link front-end traces to back-end spans, build a user experience dashboard and set an alert on a vitals regression.
days.deliverable: User experience dashboard and alert rules
checks: Vitals reported per page and device
Front-end span connects to the back-end trace
Alert fires on a slower release
objectives: Trace across front and back end

days.topic: Edge Rendering and Deployment Strategies for Nuxt
days.lab_task: Deploy the same Nuxt app to Node.js, serverless and edge targets, compare latency from three regions and cost per million requests, and run a canary release.
checks: App works on all three presets
Canary gets a share of traffic and is promoted

days.topic: AI Features in Vue Applications
subtopics: Calling AI APIs from server routes
days.lab_task: Add a product assistant to the shop that streams answers from a server route, grounds answers in product data, blocks unsafe output and tracks cost per conversation.
days.deliverable: AI assistant feature with evaluation notes
checks: Text appears as it is generated
objectives: Add AI features to Vue apps

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production Vue and Nuxt Issues
subtopics: Triage from user reports and monitoring
days.lab_task: Work through four production issues: a hydration error, a memory leak, a slow release and a browser-specific bug, find each root cause and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Multi-Team Nuxt Commerce Platform
days.lab_task: Design and build a commerce platform for three teams with Nuxt layers, a shared design system, a monorepo, hybrid rendering at the edge, offline support, security controls and monitoring, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, architecture document and defence
checks: Each team ships without blocking the others
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
